error_message: psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection refused on port 5432
root_cause: PostgreSQL StatefulSet Pod is unresponsive or network policy blocks incoming traffic on target port.
remediation: Verify pod status with 'kubectl get pods -l app=postgres' and check NetworkPolicy rules allowing port 5432 traffic.

error_message: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout - NGINX upstream timed out after 30000ms
root_cause: Downstream backend pod exceeded processing time limit or is stuck in an infinite loop/deadlock.
remediation: Increase proxy_read_timeout in NGINX ConfigMap or scale up upstream deployment replicas using 'kubectl scale'.

error_message: OOMKilled: Container memory limit exceeded (used 512Mi, limit 512Mi)
root_cause: FastAPI pod exceeded RAM ceiling during heavy payload processing or vector array generation.
remediation: Increase memory limit in deployment manifest under resources.limits.memory to 1Gi and check for memory leaks.

error_message: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu. Pod status remains Pending.
root_cause: Cluster node pool has exhausted requested CPU capacity across active workloads.
remediation: Adjust pod CPU requests downward or enable Cluster Autoscaler on Azure AKS to add worker nodes.

root_cause: Deployment references a Kubernetes Secret that has not been applied to the target namespace.
remediation: Apply missing secret using 'kubectl apply -f k8s/secret.yaml' and verify availability with 'kubectl get secrets'.

error_message: FailedMount: Read-only file system or PVC persistentvolumeclaim 'data-pvc' not bound
root_cause: PersistentVolumeClaim failed to bind to a physical persistent volume due to storage class mismatch.
remediation: Inspect PVC status with 'kubectl describe pvc' and verify underlying StorageClass driver configuration.

root_cause: Application panics immediately on boot due to corrupted configuration file or invalid command-line flag.
remediation: Check application logs using 'kubectl logs <pod_name> --previous' to inspect terminal output prior to crash.

error_message: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid for ingress endpoint
root_cause: TLS secret attached to the Ingress resource contains an expired SSL/TLS certificate.
remediation: Renew certificate via cert-manager or update tls.crt and tls.key in Kubernetes TLS Secret.

error_message: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503
root_cause: Pod is active but failing internal database connection check during startup sequence.
remediation: Verify database availability and ensure initialDelaySeconds in readinessProbe configuration allows sufficient boot time.

error_message: CUDA error: out of memory or driver failure during model load
root_cause: Model file exceeds available system GPU/RAM bounds or node lacks CUDA hardware acceleration.
remediation: Switch to a quantized model variant (e.g., qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M) or increase system RAM allocation.
